newsitem.title: DENMARK: Becalmed Danish shares poised for minor correction.
newsitem.headline: Becalmed Danish shares poised for minor correction.

text.p: Danish share prices slipped slightly in early trade on Tuesday with dealers seeing minor correction ahead after Monday's surprise gains.
"It was big orders in KFX paper which pulled the market out of the doldrums late yesterday so the expected correction should come today in a quiet, gently falling market," one dealer said.
He said the market would be watching the afternoon's U.S. employment cost data with interest.
The KFX top-20 index had lost 0.11 point to 190.49 at 0705 GMT, having closed 1.31 point higher on Monday. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom, 45-33-969652
